observationBoundary: The eight supplemental runs retain the actual relationship-selection pointerdown timestamp and event. Reads initiated during portfolio preparation are retained separately; selected reads must begin at or after the boundary and remain bound to the selected relationship. Material command observations remain global across both phases. The known authority resolve POST is explicitly classified as a read query and identity-bound.
limits: Fixture browser captures establish rendered structure and observed local requests, not live authorization or backend execution.

The retained matrix run completed all 50 matrix frames before its first supplemental preparation exposed an observer-phase error. That error remains in the raw receipt. After the observer was corrected, all eight supplemental states completed in a separate focused run. The combined manifest explicitly records both origins.

Axe incomplete aria-prohibited-attr and color-contrast readings remain in the accessibility receipt for manual interpretation; zero automated violations does not establish complete accessibility acceptance.
Named AI visual reviews do not establish four-actor execution, backend authorization, source-to-report reconciliation, or production acceptance. The 0/19 screen acceptance register is not advanced.
Only the historical synthetic partial-delivery workflow pins its clock to 2026-09-08T12:00:00.000Z; production date validation remains unchanged.

remoteVerification.record: The PR will record exact final-head CI runs and retained workflow artifact after publication.
